Hymn 41: Let Zion in Her Beauty Rise
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Edward Partridge
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 41 titled "Let Zion in Her Beauty Rise" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Edward Partridge.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
